dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Primarily smooth lateral margins; minor asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin at the mid-posterior junction.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey with a uniform tone across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Fine, light-colored linear marks (potential rake marks) visible on the left side of the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent linear dorsal ridge casting a slight shadow along the longitudinal axis of the posterior section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible fine linear scars or scratches on the left side of the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctly circular and dark-pigmented blowhole visible at the anterior end.
